decision_conditions: The amendment to the approved application listed below is considered to be of a minor nature and acceptable in its own right and not require resubmission of a fresh planning application.
The following amendment is deemed to be accepted:
- Installation of a new essential GRP enclosure to securely house critical electrical meters and the main switchboard entrance.

- Description: Variation and non-compliance with condition 2 (Approved Plans) of planning permission P0755.21 dated 27/05/2022 to allow for internal and external alterations (Erection of 2/3 storey care home for the frail elderly (Class C2 Use) with ancillary and communal accommodation, together with associated landscaping, access arrangements, car and cycle parking, servicing, refuse and recycling).
The applicant is advised that this amendment relates solely to the item detailed above and shown on drawing numbers
A100411AC - Signature Hornchurch - NMA cover letter.
Furthermore, this amendment does not in any way alter or remove any previous conditions imposed on the original approved application reference P0235.25
description: Application for a non-material amendment to planning permission Ref: P0235.25 dated 23/05/2025 to allow for the installation of a new essential GRP enclosure to securely house critical electrical meters and the main switchboard (Variation and non-compliance with condition 2 (Approved Plans) of planning permission P0755.21 dated 27/05/2022 to allow for internal and external alterations (Erection of 2/3 storey care home for the frail elderly (Class C2 Use) with ancillary and communal accommodation, together with associated landscaping, access arrangements, car and cycle parking, servicing, refuse and recycling).)
